512-1432-8190.easyPrerequisites: Loot and Ioreth of the Healing House do not have summoning sickness.
512-1432-8190.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two creatures with different powers.
512-1432-8190.description:
Activate Loot by tapping it, adding at least {W}{W}
Activate Ioreth of the Healing House by tapping it, targeting Halo Fountain.
Holding priority, activate Halo Fountain by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and untapping Ioreth of the Healing House and Loot, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Ioreth of the Healing House ability, untapping Halo Fountain.
Repeat.
512-1432-8190.notes: Once you have drawn your library, you may instead forego activating Loot's ability to activate Halo Fountain's first ability to create near-infinite 1/1 Citizen creature tokens.

147-3085-5231.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
147-3085-5231.description:
Cast Zombify by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Zombify.
Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage, adding {R}.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Zombify
Resolve the Zombify copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

1183-6495-6972.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Pentavus.
When Pentavus dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
1183-6495-6972.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

1981-2415-3899-6458.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
Thunder of Unity's second or third chapter ability has triggered this turn.
1981-2415-3899-6458.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Thunder of Unity triggers, causing you to gain life and each opponent to lose life.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

431-1308-4365-7824.notablePrerequisites: You control at least seven untapped Merfolk.
431-1308-4365-7824.description:
Whenever an opponent casts a spell, activate Lullmage Mentor by tapping seven untapped Merfolk, countering that spell.
Lullmage Mentor triggers, creating a total of eight 1/1 Merfolk creature tokens.
Repeat.

1309-2103-7370.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying its mana cost.
Kykar triggers, exiling Salvager of Secrets.
Resolve Capture of Jingzhou, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Kykar triggers, returning Salvager of Secrets from exile to the battlefield.
When Salvager of Secrets enters, it triggers, returning Capture of Jingzhou from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

2034-2169--5.description:
Activate Zameck Guildmage's first ability by paying {G}{U}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Zameck Guildmage.
Repeat from step 2.

1409-3258-7417.description:
If Beacon of Tomorrows is in your library, cast a copy of Wild Idea by paying {3}{U}{R}, searching your library for Beacon of Tomorrows and putting it into your hand.
If Sanar doesn't have summoning sickness, activate it by tapping it, creating a Treasure token. Then, activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Cast Beacon of Tomorrows by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and shuffle Beacon of Tomorrows into your library.
Blink Sanar using Deadeye Navigator. It'll enter prepared due to its static effect.
Repeat each turn.
1409-3258-7417.notes: If Beacon of Tomorrows is in your hand to start, you can skip step 1 the first iteration and save {3}{U}{R} during that iteration. If Sanar starts with summoning sickness, you need an additional {U} the first iteration.

1722-2034-2713-4365-7365.description:
Activate Katara by paying at most {4} due to Zirda, causing you to draw a card.
Nadir Kraken triggers, causing you to pay {1} to put a +1/+1 counter on it and create two creature tokens.
Activate Katara by paying at most {2} and tapping the creature tokens.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Resolve the Katara ability, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.
1722-2034-2713-4365-7365.notes: The mana cost can be reduced if you tap combo pieces or other applicable permanents while activating Katara's waterbend ability the first iteration. As the combo will net {C} each iteration, you can forego sacrificing and/or tapping both tokens on some loops.

2816-7308.description:
Activate Mona Lisa by tapping it, adding an amount of colored mana equal to its power.
Activate Mona Lisa by paying {3} and untapping it, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat.
2816-7308.notes: The cost can be reduced if Mona Lisa starts with higher power.

141-3168-7101.description:
Cast Airbending Lesson by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target(s).
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost reduced by Urza's Incubator.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, copying Airbending Lesson targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve Airbending Lesson, airbending Naru Meha.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha from exile by paying {0} due to Urza's Incubator.
Repeat from step 3.

2281-2921-4681.description:
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Karmic Guide
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Karmic Guide
When Karmic Guide dies, Saffi triggers, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

527-1409-2079.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {3}{G}{U}.
Activate Selvala by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Selvala enters, Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability triggers, repairing it and Selvala.
Repeat.

1479-1659-2841-6158.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Blighted Woodland.
1479-1659-2841-6158.description:
Fetch a land using Blighted Woodland.
When the fetched land enters, Seed the Land and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Seed the Land trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Seed the Land from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Seed the Land triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness, with power 3 or greater and with a +1/+1 counter on it

1978-2436-5517.description:
Activate Marwyn by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Marwyn.
Repeat

1497-2173-4446-5220.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Cleric
1497-2173-4446-5220.description:
Activate Wild Cantor by sacrificing it.
When Wild Cantor dies, Mortuary and Relic Vial trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Wild Cantor from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Relic Vial trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Cast Wild Cantor from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

1632-1661-1987-4423.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary and Stonespeaker Crystal by tapping them, adding {2}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Stonespeaker Crystal.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters untapped, it triggers, putting Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

1818-2034-3000-4593.description:
Activate Mite Overseer by paying {3}{W/P}, creating two creature tokens.
When the creature tokens enter the battlefield, Healer of the Pride triggers twice, causing you to gain 4 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.
1818-2034-3000-4593.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the creature tokens

719-1789-5649-6798.description:
Cast Bladewing's Thrall by paying {2}{B}{B}.
When Bladewing's Thrall enters the battlefield, Lathliss triggers.
Holding priority, activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Bladewing's Thrall.
Resolve the Lathliss trigger, creating a 5/5 Dragon creature token.
When the Dragon enters the battlefield, Bladewing's Thrall triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

645-1267-5361-6798.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
Alesha does not have summoning sickness.
645-1267-5361-6798.description:
Declare Alesha as an attacker.
Alesha triggers, causing you to pay {U/B}{U/B} to return Auton Soldier from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped and attacking as a nonlegendary copy of Medomai the Ageless.
Deal combat damage using Auton Soldier.
Auton Soldier triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Auton Soldier
Repeat each turn.

1339-1808-3967-6625.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing a creature token.
When the creature dies, Eloise's first and second abilities trigger, causing you to create a Clue token and then to surveil 1.
Matoya triggers, causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

2281-3175-5147.description:
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Sun Titan.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Sun Titan.
When Sun Titan dies, Saffi triggers, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

851-2653-5702-5954.easyPrerequisites: Springheart Nantuko attached to Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
851-2653-5702-5954.notablePrerequisites: Overlord of the Hauntwoods does not have summoning sickness.
851-2653-5702-5954.description:
Declare Overlord of the Hauntwoods as an attacker.
Overlord of the Hauntwoods triggers, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens.
When the Everywhere tokens enter the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko and Nissa each trigger twice.
Resolve both Nissa triggers, adding {1}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When the Overlord of the Hauntwoods tokens enters the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the first trigger, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens.
Repeat from step 3.

1339-2773-6092.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
1339-2773-6092.description:
Draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
When the Insect enters the battlefield, Warstorm Surge triggers, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Niv-Mizzet triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

2034-4275-5470.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to create a Human creature token, a Shaman creature token, and/or a creature token with changeling this turn.
2034-4275-5470.description:
Create a creature token that is a Human and/or Shaman, and/or has changeling.
Activate Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the creature token created in step 2, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature token dies, Faces of the Past triggers, untapping all creatures that share a creature type with it.
Repeat from step 2.

643-1636-3088.notablePrerequisites:
Maskwood Nexus and Xenic Poltergeist do not have summoning sickness.
Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {3}.
643-1636-3088.description:
Activate Xenic Poltergeist by tapping it, causing Maskwood Nexus to become an artifact creature until your next upkeep.
Activate any number of mana-producing creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}.
Activate Maskwood Nexus by paying {3} and tapping it, creating a 2/2 Shapeshifter creature token.
When the Shapeshifter enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat from step 2.
If creatures you control can tap to produce at least {4}, this combo nets infinite mana.

2438-2732-4681.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Prowling Geistcatcher's first ability triggers, exiling Karmic Guide from your graveyard.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Prowling Geistcatcher.
When Prowling Geistcatcher dies, its second ability triggers, returning Karmic Guide from exile to the battlefield.
When Karmic Guide enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Prowling Geistcatcher from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder abilities from step 1 and step 3, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.

751-1671-2653-3314.description:
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying {U}.
Chulane triggers, causing you to draw a card and put Simic Growth Chamber from your hand onto the battlefield.
Simic Growth Chamber enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Nissa.
Resolve the Nissa trigger, adding {U}.
Resolve the Simic Growth Chamber trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Shrieking Drake enters the battlefield, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

184-2713-4682.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least three opponents.
Opponents are unable to pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger.
184-2713-4682.description:
Activate Faerie Mastermind by paying {1}{U}, causing each player to draw a card.
Smothering Tithe triggers for each opponent you have, creating at least three Treasure tokens.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

915-1766-3807.notablePrerequisites: Swift Reconfiguration attached to Synod Artificer.
915-1766-3807.description:
Activate Thran Dynamo by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Synod Artificer's second ability by paying {2} and tapping it, untapping itself and Thran Dynamo.
Repeat.

305-1978-5056.description:
Cause Llanowar Tribe to become an artifact using Neurok Transmuter.
Activate Llanowar Tribe by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G}
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Llanowar Tribe.
Repeat from step 2.
